question:
5 Select the word from among the given options that is closest in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

For __leisure__, Arjun prefers to unwind by playing chess with friends.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Relaxation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"unwind"** means to relax and reduce stress or tension, often after a period of work or activity. (आराम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, Ramesh likes to unwind by listening to music.
 
 
• **"Relaxation"** refers to the state of being free from tension and stress, allowing the mind and body to rest. (विश्राम)
 
 
• **Example:** Yoga and meditation are great techniques for relaxation.
